title: Gadolinium nicotinate clusters as potential MRI contrast agents

synthesis.procedure: Modified from the procedure of Hong et al. Water (10 mL) was added to GdCl3·6H2O (750 mg, 2 mmol) and nicotinic acid (490 mg, 4 mmol). NaN3 (650 mg, 10.0 mmol) was added, followed by 300 mL of 2 M HNO3 as written in the converted experimental text. The mixture was transferred to a Teflon-lined high-pressure reactor, heated at 180 °C for three days, cooled at 1 °C per 10 min to room temperature, and filtered. Colorless crystals formed after the filtrate stood at room temperature for two days. Yield: 0.1 g (13.4% based on nicotinic acid).
synthesis.temperature: 180 °C, then cooled at 1 °C per 10 min to room temperature; crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: three days hydrothermal heating; two days standing for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered after cooling; colorless crystals obtained after the solution stood at room temperature for two days

properties.summary: Longitudinal relaxivity was measured as an MRI contrast agent. Per Gd, r1 at 7 T is 10.45 ± 0.16 mM−1 s−1 in water and 10.37 ± 0.31 mM−1 s−1 in 1% agarose; at 0.5 T in water r1 is 11.00 ± 0.25 mM−1 s−1. T1-weighted phantom images at 7 T brighten with increasing Gd concentration. Average coordinated water molecules per Gd q_ave = 2.

material_class.structural_family: distorted Gd4(μ3-OH)4 cubane with protonated nicotinate ligands

synthesis.procedure: The experimental section states that 2 was synthesized in the same way as reported by Kong et al. and that block-shaped colorless crystals were obtained. The discussion describes a one-pot ligand-controlled hydrolysis in which aqueous NaOH was added dropwise to a mixture of nicotinic acid and the gadolinium salt, with heating of the mixtures at 90 °C followed by room-temperature crystallization, but no reagent amounts are given in the main text. Yield: 0.2 g (8.2% based on nicotinic acid).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot aqueous synthesis as previously reported by Kong et al.

properties.summary: Per Gd, r1 is 9.28 ± 0.06 mM−1 s−1 in water at 7 T, 10.74 ± 0.11 mM−1 s−1 in 1% agarose at 7 T, and 10.08 ± 0.22 mM−1 s−1 in water at 0.5 T. T1-weighted 7 T phantoms intensify with Gd concentration. Average coordinated water molecules per Gd q_ave = 3.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: octanuclear dimer of tetranuclear gadolinium hydroxo-nicotinate clusters

material_class.structural_family: centrosymmetric dimer of two Gd4(μ3-OH)4 cubanes linked by nicotinate N/carboxylate bridges

synthesis.procedure: Modified from Kong et al. Nicotinic acid (0.62 g, 5 mmol) in 5 mL deionized water was titrated with 1.0 M NaOH to pH 8 and added dropwise to 10 mL of 1.0 M Gd(ClO4)3 that had itself been treated dropwise with fresh 1.0 M NaOH to the point of incipient but permanent precipitation at 90 °C. After stirring at 90 °C for one additional hour, the white turbid mixture was filtered while hot and left at room temperature for two days to give block-shaped colorless crystals. Yield: 0.13 g (8.8% based on nicotinic acid).
synthesis.temperature: 90 °C during precipitation and stirring; crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: one additional hour at 90 °C; two days standing
synthesis.ph: ligand solution adjusted to pH 8; lanthanide solution brought to incipient permanent precipitation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered hot; filtrate stood at room temperature for two days to afford block-shaped colorless crystals

properties.summary: Per Gd, r1 is 2.04 ± 0.29 mM−1 s−1 in water at 7 T, 4.60 ± 0.29 mM−1 s−1 in 1% agarose at 7 T, and 2.09 ± 0.32 mM−1 s−1 in water at 0.5 T, lower than clusters 1 and 2. T1-weighted 7 T phantoms still intensify with Gd concentration. Average coordinated water molecules per Gd q_ave = 1.5.
